name: Session host badge for remote-backed sessions (row mode, the default view, and card mode)

alsoIn.note: SessionList.tsx's "card" display mode (reached via the list header's view toggle) -- SessionRow above is the default "row" mode. Both files carry a // +feature: remote-host-badge marker; the frontend scanner only keeps whichever file it walks first and warn-skips the duplicate id from the other. `alsoIn` is a new convention introduced by this feature, not an existing repo pattern (checked: no other entry under docs/registry/features/frontend/ uses it, and no tooling reads it) -- this per-feature JSON file, not the scanner's pick, is the source of truth for which paths belong to this feature. The repo's actual existing precedent for a genuinely multi-file feature (e.g. ui:local-file-browser) is to document only one file and say nothing about the other; this entry deliberately documents both instead, since silently omitting SessionRow (the default view) understated coverage.

testIds: remote-workspaces > creates a session on the configured remote via the Omnibar remote selector and shows the host badge
